maya: Heads-up — sketching a tiny 'deploy cheat card' for on-call and release leads. Trying to capture our common rollback patterns and the minimal bot commands for fast recovery. Paste below, feedback?

maya: ```
--- DEPLOY CHEAT CARD ---
Context: service=payments, commit=<sha>, change-window=overnight
Quick pin: /deploy pin service=payments version=2025-11-09-rc3 --reason "hotfix"
Dryrun: /deploy dryrun service=payments version=2025-11-09-rc3
Canary rollout: /deploy rollout service=payments version=2025-11-09-rc3 --canary 10%
Rollforward (patch): /deploy rollforward service=payments from=rc3 to=rc3.1 --notes "perf fix"
Force rollback: /deploy rollback service=payments to=previous --reason "regression"
Abort rollout: /deploy abort run_id=REPLACE_ME
Pin-check: /deploy pin-check service=payments version=2025-11-09-rc3
Post-deploy smoke: /deploy smoke service=payments path=/health --expect "200"
Release note snippet:
  - jira: ABC-123
  - summary: Fix double-charge bug
  - owner: @maya
--- END ---
```

aj: Nice! Can we add a quick compatibility check that calls the pin-check then runs a live-traffic shadow test? e.g.

aj: `curl -fsS "https://infra/internal/pin-check?svc=payments&ver=2025-11-09-rc3" | jq .status`

deploy-bot: INFO: dryrun queued (run_id=run_8732) — estimated time 45s. Use `/deploy status run_id=run_8732` to follow.

sarah: Love the layout. Two suggestions:
1) Add `preflight-lint` step: `/deploy preflight-lint service=payments --config=standard`
2) Auto release note helper: `git log --pretty=format:"- %h %s" --no-merges <since>..HEAD` to paste into notes.

leo: For rollback playbook add: 1) flip feature flag to 0, 2) scale down new replica set, 3) run `/deploy rollback ...` as final step. Also include a short checklist for change-window ops (who to notify, pg connections, cache purge).

ops-bot: REMINDER: upcoming change window tonight 23:00-04:00 UTC. Add `--change-window=overnight` to long-running ops.

maya: Great, I'll fold these in and open a PR to infra/tooling with a small CLI alias file and a `cheat_cards/` markdown. @aj @sarah want to own the pin-check + release-note snippets? Plan to ship tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
